ramp.note: mean colour of 16 equal brightness classes of the ground of the approved close image (assets-src/sun/convect/ramp.py), display values

wide.note: the light and dark of the globe own map under the cells, at the place on the ball where the globe shows it (the ground is the globe own ground). Two parts. cell: each cell takes the map light at its own middle over the map mean round it (region, texels of the map wide), by one law at every height and distance: share is how far the sample is drawn from the point to the middle of its cell (1: each cell one light), power how it is read, least and most its bounds. The region part, that mean: amount is the share of it the ground takes, level the light of the map that leaves the ground as it is, power how it is read, most the most it adds, where a pixel is small on the ground; far is the same four where a pixel holds the map as the globe shows it, band the texels of the map to a pixel (in 1080ths of the frame height) between which the one gives way to the other. texels: the least width of a sample in texels of the map

well.note: the heat of a cell: 1 in the middle, falling to the lane by (1 - way^out)^fall; tongue: how far the flow carries tongues of hot gas outward; scale: the size of the tongues

gas.note: the ground is a slab of glowing gas. lid, floor: the slab's top over the ball and its bottom under it (stage units). steps: level cuts of a ray through it. margin: how much wider than the picture the baked diagram is. fine: texels of the baked diagram to a pixel of the picture, each way. soft: half the height over which the top of the gas fades out. free: the way through the gas of a cell that takes all but 1/e of the light. top, deep: the gas at the very top gives the share top of its heat, full heat deep under the top. cool: the cooler gas between the cells, up to fill over the ball (soft each way), within reach over the ground, free its way, heat the light it gives. air: the thin glowing air over the tops (free its way at the top, scale the height it thins by, glow the share of the heat under it that it gives). strand: the threads (light and dense: how much brighter and denser a thread is, layer: the depth from one field of threads to the other, mean: the mean of a field, far: cells a pixel between which the threads merge). pit: the march goes on into the sunspot's funnel to depth with steps cuts
